name: Amachi Shouta
source:
Amachi enters Hanegasaki High at the 2nd year, which makes him the player's junior. He has a sweet, polite personality and is very fond of sweet food, but the player can discover a different side of him that is devilishly mischievous, despite his looks. He is also quite popular with younger girls.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side:_2nd_Kiss#Male_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
